newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-POYET ACTS ON MARADONA ADVICE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-POYET ACTS ON MARADONA ADVICE.

text.p: Gustavo Poyet, Chelsea's new signing, revealed that Diego Maradona was a big influence in his decision to join the English F.A. Cup winners.

After the Uruguayan international had completed his free transfer from Spanish club Real Zaragoza on Tuesday he said: "Diego Maradona said that (Ruud) Gullit and (Gianfranco) Zola are two of the best players in the world and the fact that they are at the club attracted me to sign.

Poyet, an attacking midfielder, believes Chelsea will succeed in both the the premier league and the European Cup Winners' Cup with the brand of continental-style soccer emerging under manager Gullit.
"Unlike most English clubs Chelsea play a continental style. I can fit into that," said Poyet. "They play the ball through the midfield and that suits my game.
"I think we will do well in Europe But I think we can succeed in the premier league, too. I came here to win the league."
Poyet is Chelsea's fifth close season signing, all of them foreigners. The others are Tore Andre Flo, Bernard Lambourde, Ed de Goey and Celestine Babayaro.
Chelsea managing director Colin Hutchinson said: "It would be nice to bring in one or two English players but the current market value for them will not allow it."
